fields.title: 200 F process and compliant-core bond interpretation
fields.finding: The stress-free cure reference, compliant in-plane core, free-edge transfer and foil yield proxy are conditional. Existing tests do not qualify the precise 2U .015/Be/honeycomb assembly.
fields.needed: Retain the inherited 037b and CHECK-040 qualification rows and test the intended assembly/process, including edge/scarf coincidence and peel.
